ch.h: It was during a time like this, where we were having an argument, or you may call it a discussion, about things such as flaws, compatibility, marriage, past and such, that I was reminded of our first days, the days, where I ended up liking a girl, in a place I had made a vow before entering that I will control my heart and not fall in for a girl. If you would have known me, you would have said, ahhh, so Sajeel said that. Well, it becomes only a matter of ‘till how long’ a promise like that lasts.
